title: BetterPauseMenu (BPM)
description: It enhances the Pausemenu if you press "esc"
body:
# 🎮 Better Pause Menu

> A sleek, modern redesign of Minecraft's default pause screen.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Dark & Sleek UI** — Clean card layout with rounded panels and a blue accent bar
- **Live Player Skin** — Your character is displayed on the left side of the menu
- **Color-coded Buttons** — Each button has its own color for quick recognition
- **Lightweight** — 100% client-side, works on any server without any server-side installation

---

## 🖱️ Buttons

| Color | Button |
|-------|--------|
| 🟢 Green | Resume Game |
| 🔵 Cyan | Options |
| 🟡 Yellow | Statistics |
| 🟣 Purple | Resource Packs |
| 🟠 Orange | Disconnect |
| 🔴 Red | Quit Minecraft |

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|-------------|---------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.x |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.15.0 |
| Fabric API | any |
| Java | 21+ |

---
